name: Employment discrimination charges to the EEOC, by state and basis, FY 2009 to FY 2025
description: Charges of workplace discrimination received by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC), by state, DC, Puerto Rico and territory, fiscal year and basis (race, sex, national origin, religion, color, retaliation, age, disability, equal pay, genetic information and pregnancy under the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act), from the EEOC's Tables E1b and E1a. One record per jurisdiction and basis for the latest fiscal year, each with its count, its share of the state's charges, the rate per 100,000 private-sector workers (BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, from fiscal year 2014) and the whole FY 2009 to FY 2025 history. A charge can name more than one basis, so bases add up to more than the total, and charges filed only with a state or local fair-employment agency are not counted.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Employment discrimination charges to the EEOC, by state and basis, FY 2009 to FY 2025 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898101

distribution.name: eeoc-charges.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: eeoc-charges.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: eeoc-charges-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in eeoc-charges-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to eeoc-charges.csv on id.

recordSet.name: eeoc-charges
recordSet.description: The records of Employment discrimination charges to the EEOC, by state and basis, FY 2009 to FY 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: basis
field.description: all, race, sex, national-origin, religion, color, retaliation (all statutes), retaliation-title-vii, age, disability, equal-pay, genetic-information or pregnancy-pwfa

field.name: fy
field.description: The EEOC fiscal year (October 1 to September 30)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
